channel_assignment.method: per turn, the speaking channel must carry energy and the other must not
per turn, the speaking channel must carry energy and the other must not

timeline.word_timing: mora-weighted proportional allocation from pyopenjtalk run_frontend

corrections_made_during_this_step.problem: A dialogue is B-A-B, so B speaks twice and A once; the whole-channel ratio favours B by construction and all 160 pairs failed.
corrections_made_during_this_step.now: per-turn: during each turn the speaking channel carries energy and the other carries none
corrections_made_during_this_step.note: This corrects WHAT is measured, not the threshold. The requirement is stricter than before, because the whole-channel comparison diluted A across B's two turns.
corrections_made_during_this_step.reported_ratio_is_meaningless: An earlier draft of this report quoted per-turn RMS ratios of 5e11 and 4e12. Those are an artefact: the timeline has no overlap, so the non-speaking channel is digitally zero during a turn and the ratio is whatever epsilon sat in the denominator. The check is sound - a left/right swap silences the speaking channel and fails it - but the number is not evidence of margin and has been removed rather than presented as one.

corrections_made_during_this_step.was: surface string equality between script and transcript
corrections_made_during_this_step.problem: pyopenjtalk's frontend expands numerals - 1931 becomes 千九百三十一 - which is what is actually spoken. v-063 failed on it.
corrections_made_during_this_step.verified: A dropped word still fails the reading comparison.
corrections_made_during_this_step.precedent: M2's intelligibility gate had the same fault, scoring Whisper's orthography rather than pronunciation, and failed a working checkpoint 26/30.

honest_note: V-tts is 28.63 minutes against V-real's 27.83, a 2.9% difference, because the TTS renders speaker A slightly slower than the corpus recordings. The scripts, split, speaker-B audio and timeline are identical; only channel A's bytes differ, which is the intended difference. No parity threshold was pre-registered, so this is reported rather than gated.
limits: Word timings are proportional allocation, not forced alignment: right on average, wrong in detail. The floor and the agreement checks bound the consequence; they do not measure the alignment error.
The timeline has no overlap, so the model never trains toward barge-in.
